widgets.css: body{padding:0;color:var(--widget-text)}.weather{font:14px system-ui;padding:20px 14px 22px;color:var(--widget-text)}header{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}header>div{display:grid;gap:5px}header b{font-size:15px}header small{font-size:11px;color:var(--widget-muted)}.clock{text-align:right;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}.current{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:30px}.current>span{font-size:42px;color:#f5cc68}strong{display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:7px;font-size:52px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-2px}strong small{display:inline-block;flex:0 0 auto;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:0}p{text-align:center;margin:18px 0 10px;font-weight:600}.stats{text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:var(--widget-muted)}.forecast{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px;margin-top:28px}.forecast>div{display:grid;gap:12px;text-align:center;min-width:0}.forecast span{font-size:24px;color:#f5cc68}.forecast b,.forecast small{font-size:10px}.forecast small{color:var(--widget-muted)}@media(max-width:280px){.weather{padding-inline:10px}.clock{font-size:10px}header b{font-size:13px}strong{font-size:44px}}

widgets.name: 家庭能耗
widgets.css: body{padding:0;color:var(--widget-text);background:transparent}#energy{min-width:0}electricity-info-card{display:block}.energy-summary{font:14px system-ui;padding:18px 14px;color:var(--widget-text)}h3{font-size:15px;margin:0 0 14px}.accounts{display:flex;gap:6px}.accounts button{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid var(--widget-line);border-radius:8px;background:#ffffff16;color:inherit;padding:9px 5px;font:600 10px system-ui;cursor:pointer}.accounts button.active{background:#469ff5;color:white;border-color:#a4d6ff}.overview{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin:22px 0 18px}.balance{display:grid;gap:6px;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;text-align:left;padding:0;cursor:pointer}.balance small,.meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--widget-muted)}.balance strong{font-size:27px;white-space:nowrap}.meta{display:grid;gap:7px;text-align:right;max-width:52%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.summary-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.stat{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:5px;min-width:0;padding:10px 9px 14px;border:1px solid var(--widget-line);border-radius:9px;background:#ffffff0d;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;text-align:left}.stat>span{font-size:12px}.stat b{font-size:18px}.stat small{font-size:10px}.stat .cost{opacity:.8}.mini-bars{position:absolute;right:7px;bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:2px;height:20px}.mini-bars i{width:3px;height:9px;background:#4da7f6;border-radius:2px}.mini-bars i:nth-child(2){height:16px}.mini-bars i:nth-child(3){height:21px}button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #439ffa;outline-offset:2px}@media(max-width:280px){.energy-summary{padding-inline:10px}.summary-stats{gap:5px}.stat{padding-inline:6px}.stat b{font-size:16px}}
